reverse_hunks.current:
required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

      private_current429_forward_capture:
        description: Verify four exact SQL changes and rollback on signed backup 45645963579
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

      current429_candidate_commit:
        description: Exact candidate commit for the four-SQL rehearsal
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""

      deploy_current429_if_verified:
        description: Apply the four SQL changes only after a successful signed 429 rehearsal

if test "$PRIVATE_CURRENT429_FORWARD_CAPTURE" = true; then
            test "$BACKUP_RUN_ID" = '45645963579'
            [[ "$CURRENT429_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]
            test "$CURRENT429_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
            test "$REHEARSAL_SCOPE" = backup_only
            test "$OFFICIAL_LOCAL_STORAGE_PROVIDER" = true
            test "$PRIVATE_CURRENT428_FORWARD_CAPTURE" != true
            test "$PRIVATE_CONTEXT_COST_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY" != true
            encrypted="${RUNNER_TEMP}/encrypted-backup/memphis-zoo-backup.tar.gz.enc"
            test "$(stat -c '%s' "$encrypted")" = '96961760'
            printf '86e4a42617a7da2c9b6b28ef24a8d3cef9e0e64580fba77aa94666effb8cf3db  %s\n' "$encrypted" | sha256sum --check --status
          fi

run: |
          if test "$PRIVATE_CURRENT429_FORWARD_CAPTURE" = true; then
            node scripts/verify-current429-rehearsal.mjs
          fi
          npm run --silent release:migrations:attest-rehearsal > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/production-backup-migration-rehearsal-attestation.json"

apply_current429:
    needs: rehearse
    if: inputs.private_current429_forward_capture && inputs.deploy_current429_if_verified
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.4'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: production-backup-migration-rehearsal-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/current429-signed-rehearsal
      - name: Verify signed rehearsal and apply the exact four SQL changes
        shell: bash
        env:
          CURRENT429_PRODUCTION_APPLY: ${{ inputs.deploy_current429_if_verified }}
          CURRENT429_EXPECTED_CANDIDATE: ${{ inputs.current429_candidate_commit }}
          CURRENT429_PROJECT_CONFIRMATION: rqquvtjdmugpigbndmne
          CURRENT429_SIGNED_REHEARSAL_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/current429-signed-rehearsal
          SUPABASE_DB_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_MIGRATION_DB_URL }}
          SUPABASE_DB_CA_CERT_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/.github/certs/prod-ca-2021.crt
          RELEASE_REHEARSAL_ATTESTATION_VERIFY_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_REHEARSAL_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY }}
          RELEASE_REHEARSAL_ATTESTATION_VERIFY_KEY_ID: ${{ vars.RELEASE_REHEARSAL_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY_ID }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/apply-current429-forward-plan.mjs 2>&1 | tee "${RUNNER_TEMP}/current429-apply-receipt.jsonl"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: current429-apply-receipt-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/current429-apply-receipt.jsonl
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
